start.text: Banquo. You're back. Good... the street telemetry you fed me kept the War-Rig fed. But listen to me — the grid isn't silent tonight. Every time I power up the neural stack, I hear data-fluid dripping. Did Duncan's servers have a leak, or is it just the ICE?

choices.text: It's just the ICE, Mack. Focus on the next convoy.
You look terrible, Mack. Have you rested?
I'll be out on the streets. [Leave]

convoy_talk.text: Focus? I've never been more focused! Macduff thinks he can split his battalion across four entry vectors. He thinks distributed routing will hide him from my War-Rig. I'll crush them all in the central lane. One lane, Banquo. That's all I need.

choices.text: The War-Table is set when you're ready to deploy.
Who was Bankes to you, Mack?

madness_talk.text: Rest?! There is no rest while Duncan's ghost-code lingers on the overmap! Lady M says the throne is ours, but every time I look at the cockpit HUD, Bankes' name flashes red across my scope! He's dead, Banquo! I saw the wreckage burn! SO WHY IS HE STILL PINGING MY NEURAL CORE?!

choices.text: Breathe, Mack. It's just a phantom signal from the cyberware.

bankes_talk.text: Bankes was a fool who thought loyalty to Duncan meant something in a city made of scrap and silicon. He died in the highway split. And if his ghost-code tries to stop the War-Rig... I'll burn his neural signature out of the sky too!

ready_to_fight.text: I'm always ready. Deploy me from the War-Table at The Pit when the signal is green. Then watch the highway burn.
